No additional faces remained and exactly 864 K1 simplices survived; pair counts by free face dimensions 1..5 were 168,672,696,144,24. Hence the inclusion is a homotopy equivalence; W(F4) representation on H3 follows from equivariant 24-cell subdivision, not a purported equivariant collapse.
